slice: Remove Project actually removes the row, and the desktop patch set applies from the pinned base
method: desktop patch 0010 change + apps/macos session item + CDP right-click on the running Agents window with the Caret extension loaded + direct host API calls + bun test + bun run typecheck + node scripts/ci-validate.mjs

problem.symptom: right-clicking a project row and choosing Remove Project archived the host's project record, but the row stayed in the sidebar - the user could not remove caret-ui-acceptance
problem.detail: the sidebar's project row is the chats' workspace group, built from the sessions the extension lists. The extension never set item.archived, so the desktop provider built every session with isArchived=false and the list kept the row in its workspace group. Archiving the project record alone changes no session, so nothing about the row could move.
problem.secondFinding: 3 of the 23 mirrored desktop patches (0012, 0021, 0022) did not apply to the pinned base at all: each had been regenerated from the already-patched working tree and carried hunks that earlier patches (0001, 0005, 0010, 0023, 0024) already apply. bun run prepare:desktop therefore could not rebuild the checkout; nothing checked it, and the mirror still reverse-checked clean because the checkout really did contain every hunk twice over.

change.extensionItem: chat-sessions-map.ts carries the host's archived flag in sessionItemShape, and applyItem publishes it as item.archived.
change.extensionRemove: removeProject now archives the project's chats with its record (the row is a chat group, so that is what removing it means), and both removeProject and archiveProjectChats ask the chat session registration to republish. registerCaretChatSessions returns that refresh; activation wires it to the provider.
change.desktop: ExtensionSessionsProvider.refresh replaces an existing session whose archived flag changed - isArchived is fixed when a session is constructed, so reuse would keep the row where it was - and fires it as changed so the list regroups.
change.copy: the confirmation says the chats are archived with the project, not that they move to a Done section: the list keeps archived rows out of sight until a filter asks for them, so Done is not what the user sees.
change.patchSet: 0012 drops the ChatAIDisabledSettingId hunk that 0001 owns, 0021 drops the sessions.common.main.ts hunk that 0005 owns, and 0022 drops the extensionSessions / prompt-options / context-row import hunks that 0010, 0023 and 0024 own. 0010 is regenerated from its own file only. Digests updated for all four.

verified.liveRemove: with the Caret extension loaded in the dev Agents window: right-click the caret-ui-acceptance group row, Remove Project, confirm -> the sidebar goes from 2 sections to 1 (the group disappears) with no reload, and the toast reads 'Removed caret-ui-acceptance from Caret. Its chats are archived and its folder is untouched.'
verified.hostState: after the same flow, GET projects shows archived=true and GET sessions shows archived=true for that project and its chat.
verified.itemFlag: a temporary trace in the provider logged '[extensionSessions] DIAG items=[New task:true]' at startup after the archive, proving the host's flag reaches the desktop through the extension item; the trace was removed before the commit.
verified.patchSetApplies: base + all 23 patches in manifest order -> 23/23 applied. The tree that produces is byte-identical to the desktop checkout across all 1888 changed/untracked files, so the repair changed no behaviour. git apply --reverse --check still passes for all 23 against the checkout.
verified.patchSetTest: apps/macos/test/desktop-patch-set.test.ts builds a temp tree from the base revision, applies the patch set in order, and compares every patched file with the checkout. Negative control: re-inserting 0022's duplicate extensionSessions import makes it fail with 'patch does not apply'.
verified.unitTests: apps/macos/test/chat-sessions-map.test.ts - the shape carries the host's archived flag (true and false); 712 pass / 0 fail across packages/omp-adapter, packages/relay, apps/host, apps/macos/test
verified.ci: node scripts/ci-validate.mjs -> CI-OK parents=198 ui=75 children=129 lock-shas=10 doc-links=69 md=83; bun run check:cursor-parity -> OK, 340 keys, 0 mismatches

notVerified: The packaged Caret macOS app: every live run used the dev Agents window with the built extension copied in, not a --package build.
Where archived chats are visible: the sidebar showed no Done section after the removal, and the filter that would show archived rows was not exercised.
The other five project menu entries (pin, rename, reveal, worktree, archive chats) were not run live; only their command registration and the remove path were.
The dev window's extension copy (desktop/extensions/caret and desktop/.build/extensions/caret) is refreshed by hand here; bun run build --desktop is what normally does it.
